notes.title: CCD&B version 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[b]CCD&B has been upgraded to a better engine (RPG Maker MV)![/b]

[h1]So what does that mean?[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/e52a35df8957f4ec77bc4b831bb9cc8dbc1242ae.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/6b04cfba355235406ff8538f5f5885f58d9a6b12.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/8aaeec68f611cbf0d10bfbeb928348b6210cbeb1.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/e4b1934bec3806df2ff660eac22a25deafcc19e8.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/a2dfef649a505c8ecc992727dd710e23308f33f3.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/a2e76f4b1c4b42506104f36083554ec2f83d7e07.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/4b69a0d28992d8107285f8a36bf660c8368f366a.png[/img]

[h1]You can now add Hermina Lumen is Only Human to your wishlist![/h1]
Enjoyed CCD&B? The sister game starring Hermina, [b]Hermina Lumen is Only Human[/b], is in the works! You can now add it to your Steam wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898050/Hermina_Lumen_is_Only_Human/]here[/url].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/7a514d5c3f64b228a8298257274ed366dbfe70a4.png[/img]

[h1]"Hey, wait! I was in the middle of a playthrough on 1.0!"[/h1]
No worries— when you launch the game, it'll let you choose between 1.0 or 2.0. Please note that the option to launch 1.0 will be deprecated on 08/10/19. For reference, one run of the game averages about 2 hours.

[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]
If you encounter any issues in 2.0, please feel free to shout it by either emailing me at support @ badchalk.com or by making a post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/473920/discussions/]Discussion board[/url].

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards are now available! And did somebody say "spinoff game"?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/a00443b68fdba885b8cfd52cdf9ae2ca3fda1f88.jpg[/img]

1 year ago, Corinne Cross's Dead & Breakfast was released on Steam. Today, I'm happy to announce Steam Trading Cards! These were a popular request, so I hope you enjoy and have fun collecting.

Thanks for supporting the Dead & Breakfast!

Also...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/b75ba09a139ffca69ab86ded89b1bcd326f4d7c7.jpg[/img]

Did you know a spinoff/sister game is in the works? [i]Hermina Lumen is Only Human[/i] tells the story of a certain creepy funeral director before she was a creepy funeral director. Its gameplay is structured very similarly to CCD&B, but with an all new story and adventures (and on a much better engine). [url=http://badchalk.tumblr.com/post/156740883062/announcing-my-new-in-progress-project-hermina]Find out more and see some screenshots here![/url]

Thanks for a wonderful year!

Feel free to check out Bad Chalk's social media for updates and bonus content/fun extras!
